title: Personal Training Packages: counting the free trainer-reassignment allowance on a package
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the free trainer-reassignment allowance is counted on a specific package.

## Rule
A member may request a trainer reassignment, or staff may perform one to reconcile the package's trainer-of-record with the trainer actually named on the most recent reassignment entry for that package. The first reassignments logged against a given package, up to the tier's own free-use allowance, are free; each further reassignment logged against that same package is chargeable rather than free.

## Points of judgement
- If the running count of reassignments already logged against this same package is below the tier's own free-use allowance, the next reassignment on that package is free.
- If that running count has already reached the tier's own free-use allowance, the next reassignment on that package is chargeable.
The count looks only at reassignments already logged against this same package; reassignments logged against a different package the member also holds are never added to this package's own running count.
